fields.description: Weekly issue of Miami Life dated November 24, 1934 (Vol. 9, No. 10). Prominent political commentary criticizes Miami mayor Everest George Sewell and discusses city commission affairs and Miami Beach politics. Includes coverage and promotion of horse racing and betting information (including references to Hialeah, Tropical Park, Bowie, and Epsom Downs in Texas), along with extensive advertising and listings of radio broadcast programs.
